column4: cov_a_champ, championship and cov_k3_career: sg_run_boot returns -11 (missing exe constants / game file) after every record (573/573, 2305/2305, 60/60) as soon as one gfx.snapshotAt is pending, with or without LiveTerrain; the same boot without snapshotAt (boot gate, and gfx.attach alone) passes with code 0. framegate marks the 22 checkpoints NOT_RUN (bad_boot: div is None). The sim hashes of all records match. 3_rerun_noend.py re-labels that boot KNOWN and keeps the rows whose snapshot was taken (17 of 22: 15 UNSUPPORTED, 2 PASS); 5 checkpoints took no snapshot and stay NOT_RUN. Cause of -11 not found (the call path that raises it at end of input with a snapshot pending).

terrain_verdict (G2): the terrain pass draws no pixels at HEAD, so the denominator is the in-game view region's area (334,888 px). Of 521 terrain-yes rows with a snapshot 1 PASS (cov_a_keys/k_worldmap, view 0 px) and 520 FAIL (view one-level 0.004..4.292 % of area; the 70-px beyond-one-level limit is the usual failure). championship/tournament_end has no snapshot.
